I've been using Insomnia since it was a Chrome extension and the new 3.0 release is an amazing upgrade. I strongly agree with the developer that tools like Postman are quite bloated and complex for normal development tasks. Insomnia is very lightweight and refreshing!
I've been using Insomnia since the beginning and I really appreciate how receptive gschier is to feedback and how the support side of things are handled.
Executionable which won't run on my machine (Fedora) and not open source, guess I will be staying with Advance Rest Client then.
Your app is a web view running inside a copy of Chrome. That is not a 'native' app.
The Windows installer is 60MB and it's 64-bit-only? ... Especially when it claims to be 'A simple and beautiful REST API client'... still not quite what I consider 'simple'.
having the ability to call frequently used API requests without having to re-enter JSON data will be very useful. Nice app, thanks gschier.
We've been using Postman... it's been working great for our team. The sync and export features are killer. But I like the dark theme and the vertical split in Insomnia, will give it a try.
Wow, big congrats to the folks behind Insomnia. I am amazed at the rate they keep improving it. The tool is ultra polished and the love that goes into it is so clear.

I love Insomnia and use it almost daily... Please don't make the same mistake as Postman... got way too much bloat and tries to nudge me into creating a user account etc. Please don't take Insomnia down that path.

I used insomnia for a while, it was ok and felt more lightweight than postman. But then after using it for about a month it started crashing for no reason... did a clean uninstall... reinstalled but same.
Insomnia is great. Support for Flatpak would be awesome ;-)
I started using this today. It's good so far. I can now stop spinning up swagger editor in a container and work with this. Going to switch over to this fully since I was already using Insomnia.
